info.title: Redis Agent Playbooks Control Plane API
info.description:
Administrative API for Redis Agent Playbooks provisioning and policy.

Operations and fields marked `x-deployment: cloud` are available on Redis Cloud only. Self-managed deployments don't serve those operations and never return those fields.

get.description: Lists account databases using Playbook eligibility. Free plans remain visible even when ineligible or not ready.
Lists models supported by this deployment. On-prem returns the configured embedding allowlist; cloud may also advertise extraction models.
Returns configured control-plane egress addresses for database allow-listing. Requires operator read authority.

Lists the account's Playbooks. If a selected database is unavailable, its Playbook remains listed with state=UNAVAILABLE and without endpoint, database name or accessCidrs enrichment for recognized missing/deleted database or metadata connection failures. Other inventory enrichment failures retain the saved state.

get.description: Reads one Playbook. A missing or deleted database, or a recognized metadata connection failure, returns saved configuration with state=UNAVAILABLE and without endpoints, databaseBinding.name, or databaseBinding.accessCidrs. This effective read state is not persisted and is not a mutation input. It reports unavailable live database information, not confirmed deletion or a content Redis health probe. Authorization, certificate-verification, cancellation/deadline, malformed-response, and unrelated service errors still fail the request.

post.description: Administratively clears ALL, ENTRIES or PROPOSALS from a READY Playbook, preserving configuration and index readiness. Requires product_admin or suite_admin. Cleanup is not atomic across content: failures can leave partial progress; retry the same scope after resolving the failure. Without new writes, repeating a successful clear removes no additional entry families.

post.description: Validates caller management consent, exact same-account Redis Agent Memory source ownership, destination readiness and execution scope synchronously. Success returns ready and enabled=false. Every explicit enable revalidates with the current caller. Pause/delete require destination management only and make no source or grant-administration request. A foreign or missing source is refused without revealing its metadata.

CreateExtractionBindingResponseContent.description: Durable tenant-owned metadata for one Playbook, one Redis Agent Memory store, and one FAQ policy. Creation synchronously validates caller consent and exact Redis Agent Memory source ownership, returning READY and disabled. Every explicit enable revalidates with the current caller. revision.description: Optimistic configuration revision, independent of schedules and job runs. Opaque: send it back as expectedRevision.

blockedReason.description: Machine-readable runtime failure reason, such as source_not_found or source_access_denied. Clients must tolerate unknown reasons.

previewTokenBudgetEnabled.description: Enforces previewTokenBudget for REST and MCP discovery when true. Defaults to false on create. Enabling requires a configured budget; disabling retains it. Explicit null is rejected.

previewTokenBudget.description: Saved estimated ceiling on one discovery preview payload, retained while disabled and omitted until configured. Supplying it alone does not enable budgeting. Explicit null is rejected. Estimates use stored o200k_base preview tokens plus fixed allowances; this does not limit the agent's total context window, conversation history, model framing or subsequently fetched Skill content.

DiscoveryConfigUpdate.description: Partial discovery-policy update. Each omitted field retains its current value; explicit null is rejected. The resulting policy must be valid before saving. Enabling requires a budget supplied here or already stored; disabling retains the saved limit.

previewTokenBudget.description: Estimated ceiling on one discovery preview payload, using stored o200k_base estimates over compact preview JSON plus fixed allowances. It does not limit the agent's total context window, conversation history, model framing or subsequently fetched Skill content. Zero never means disabled.

ExtractionBindingSource.description: Typed Redis Agent Memory store reference. Only REDIS_AGENT_MEMORY with a client-supplied storeId is supported. The source is implicitly whole-store. The control plane verifies source consent and same-account/tenant Redis Agent Memory ownership on create and every explicit enable. Namespace selection is not supported. Credentials are never accepted here. Unknown fields are rejected.

storeId.description: A Redis Agent Memory store or namespace ID: letters, digits, `_` and `-`, so minted `st_` store IDs fit.

ExtractionJobConfiguration.description: One extraction kind and its user-owned policy. Scan cadence is deployment-owned worker configuration and is not accepted in requests or returned on bindings. Omitted idleWindowSeconds defaults to 1800 on create and retains its existing value on update. Idle bounds are 60–86400 seconds. Model context and output budgets are deployment-owned worker settings rather than binding fields. Job kind is immutable; changing extraction kind requires a new binding. Policy changes advance the binding revision and do not reset completed-source deduplication.

ExtractionJobKind.description: Exactly one extraction job kind. Skill extraction is reserved for future implementation and is currently rejected.

storeId.description: Optional deployment-configured suggestion; not an approval or verification of this store.

new value, and a resource never gets a value it had before. Compare for equality
only; its format is the service's, so only its length is constrained. Returned as
`revision`; sent back as `expectedRevision` to make a write conditional. Omitting
`expectedRevision` makes the write unconditional.
